Hiii my partner (from the UK) also lived in Australia for two years on the WHV, we had to show a police check from Australia and we couldn’t get a single status document so we have to get an affidavit made - a statutory declaration, that said: 

“He was born in the UK. He’s single under UK law.
He lived in Australia from [Month/Year] to [Month/Year]. During this time, he remained single and never entered into a marriage or civil partnership. This document shall act as his formal declaration of single status for that period.

He haven't been back to Australia since ___.”

Our police check had expired since the in person document meeting but because he hadn’t been back they said this affidavit would work instead of having to get another one done. Oh also all of it had to be apostilled (the Police check in Australia) and the Affidavit he did in the UK so buy the UK gov.

Sorry for the long answer happy to talk more over PM but we literally went through all this and it’s an ordeal.
